Usage: cloudsplaining [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Cloudsplaining is an AWS IAM Assessment tool that identifies violations of
  least privilege and generates a risk-prioritized HTML report.

Options:
  --version  Show the version and exit.
  --help     Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  create-exclusions-file          Creates a YML file to be used as a custom
                                  exclusions template
  create-multi-account-config-file
                                  Creates a YML file to be used for multi-
                                  account scanning
  download                        Runs aws iam get-authorization-details on
                                  all accounts specified in the aws
                                  credentials file, and stores them in
                                  account-alias.json
  expand-policy                   Expand the * Actions in IAM policy files to
                                  improve readability
  scan                            Scan a single file containing AWS IAM
                                  account authorization details and generate
                                  report on IAM security posture.
  scan-multi-account              Scan multiple AWS Accounts using a config
                                  file
  scan-policy-file                Scan a single policy file to identify
                                  identify missing resource constraints.

--all-access-levels.help: Include 'read' or 'list' actions in the results. Defaults to 'modify' only actions

--check.help: Exit non-zero if the base file is not already fully enriched (CI guard).

--config.help: Path of the multi-account config file

--credentials-file.help: Path to the AWS credentials file.

--exclusions-file.help: A yaml file containing a list of policy names to exclude from the scan.

--file.help: Path to the JSON policy file.

--filter-severity.help: Filter the severity of findings to be reported.

--flag-all-risky-actions.help: Flag all risky actions, regardless of whether resource ARN constraints or conditions are used.

--flag-trust-policies.help: Flag risky trust policies in roles.

--high-priority-only.help: If issues are found, only print the high priority risks (Resource Exposure, Privilege Escalation, Data Exfiltration). This can help with prioritization.

--include-non-default-policy-versions.help: When downloading AWS managed policy documents, also include the non-default policy versions. Note that this will dramatically increase the size of the downloaded file.

--input.help: Path to the JSON policy file.

--input-file.help: Path to the JSON policy file.

--minimize.help: Reduce the size of the HTML Report by pulling the Cloudsplaining Javascript code over the internet.

--no-checks-seconds.help: Retry delay when a fresh push has not registered any checks yet

--no-checks-timeout-seconds.help: Maximum time to wait for checks to register before reporting no checks

--output.help: Path to store the output. Defaults to current directory.

--output-file.help: Relative path to output file where we want to store the exclusions template.

--path.help: Scan exactly this file (repeatable). Omit to use git-diff mode.

--poll-seconds.help: Polling interval while checks are pending or gh is transiently failing

--pr.help: PR number (defaults to current branch PR)

--profile.help: Specify 'all' to authenticate to AWS and scan from *all* AWS credentials profiles. Specify a non-default profile here. Defaults to the 'default' profile.

--role-name.help: The name of the IAM role to assume in target accounts. Must be the same name in all target accounts.
